name: AI 知识库
desc: 用 Claude Code 加 Obsidian 搭的一套自用知识库：资料丢进去，AI 按我写的 SOP 通读、写摘要、交叉引用，还会定期体检——查互相矛盾的结论、没人链接的孤立条目、该补的缺口。
desc_en: A knowledge base I run on Claude Code and Obsidian: sources go in, and the AI reads them through, summarises and cross-links them by an SOP I wrote — then runs a periodic health check for contradictions, orphaned notes and gaps worth filling.

name: Claude-Anki
desc: 把笔记自动加工成带真人发音的记忆卡片。已经产出 5 个牌组、260 张卡，每天在用。
desc_en: Turns my notes into flashcards with real human pronunciation, automatically. Five decks and 260 cards so far, reviewed every day.

name: 个人网站
desc: 你正在看的这个站。Next.js 16 静态导出，没有后台，所有内容都是仓库里的 markdown；黑白设计，中英双语。
desc_en: The site you're reading. A statically exported Next.js 16 build with no backend — every page is markdown in the repo. Monochrome by design, bilingual throughout.
